page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.16xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine instance configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6763P-C processor running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, providing 30717 GB of SSD capacity. This high-capacity local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. The instance does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of local SSD storage and the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.i5e.16xlarge offers a specialized hardware profile designed for data-intensive operations. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, big data analytics, and storage-heavy workloads that require high-throughput local disk access and substantial memory capacity without the need for hardware acceleration.
